name: std::shared_lock<Mutex>::operator bool
intro: Checks whether *this owns a locked mutex or not. Effectively calls owns_lock().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if *this has an associated mutex and has acquired shared ownership of it, false otherwise.
